lessons.title: pre_ci fix loop: a format/mypy regression while fixing UT burns the whole next attempt — keep edits ≤120 chars and mypy-clean as you go
lessons.symptom: run 34078835752 step-1: attempt-1 was format-OK and mypy CLEAN (all 3 python versions) with 34 UT failures. attempt-2 fixed UT mocks but introduced 24 format violation lines + 4 mypy issues. attempt-3 (only ~2min of model time) spent itself recovering format/mypy back to clean and closed UT only 30→5 — budget out, revert, 0/8 steps. The regression, not the contract, is what exhausted the budget.
lessons.root_cause: While updating test mocks/parametrize, new lines were written wider than 120 chars and new constructor kwargs were added without matching the upstream type surface — mechanical regressions that pre_ci then forced a full attempt to recover.
fix_guidance: When fixing UT, change ONLY what the failure names: no reflow, no refactor, no reformatting of surrounding code
Wrap long parametrize ids / construction calls to ≤120 chars AS YOU WRITE them — a format violation found next round costs one full attempt
New ctor kwargs must match the upstream definition's types exactly (re-read the dataclass/def); mypy-clean attempt-1 code regressing to 4 issues means the edit drifted from the contract
